tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Who this key belongs to, the plan, how many monitors and scans are left today, whether the key is read-only, and which alert integrations (email, Slack, Teams, JIRA, Linear) are connected, with the page to connect each. Call this first.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List the monitored domains on this account with uptime status, uptime %, security grade and exposure grade. Filter by status or part of a domain name; page with cursor.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: One monitor: uptime status, last check, response time, uptime % (24h, 30d), open incident, security and exposure grades.

tools.name: get_security_result
tools.description: The latest scheduled security scan of a monitored domain, with every check (pass/warn/fail) and exposure findings. Does not run a scan or use quota.

tools.name: run_scan
tools.description: Run a security scan of any public domain now (2-10 s) and return the grades, every check, and what changed since this account's previous scan of it. Uses 1 scan from the daily quota. Optional min_grade / no_drop return gate.passed and a reason, for deploy checks.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Check how ready any public website is for AI assistants and crawlers (5-15 s): llms.txt, robots.txt rules per AI bot (GPTBot, ClaudeBot and others), agents.txt, MCP and OpenAPI discovery, structured data. Returns a 0-100 score, grade and every check. The same check as internetsecure.org/ai-readiness

tools.name: check_speed
tools.description: Test how fast any public website's home page loads (5-20 s): server response time, redirects, compression, caching, page weight, and the problems found with how to fix each. Measured from one server with curl, not a browser. The same test as internetsecure.org/speed. Uses 1 scan from the daily quota

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Fetch an earlier scan run by this account, by scan id.

tools.name: add_monitor
tools.description: Add a domain to the account: uptime checks every 10 s and daily security scans (both on by default). Needs a full-access key and a free monitor slot. Logged in the Activity Log, where it can be undone.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Change a monitor: pause or resume uptime checks, turn security scans on or off, change the check path, or turn alert channels on or off. Send only what changes. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account · Public sink: get_account, update_monitor · Destructive: get_security_result, run_scan, get_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account · Public sink: get_account, update_monitor · Destructive: get_security_result, run_scan, get_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
